build_ITM_head: build an Image-Text Matching transformer head using BertPooler and BertOnlyNSPHead for next sentence prediction
create_ITM_Config: create an ITM head configuration with hidden_size 768 and custom loss_name and ignore_index settings
run_ITM_forward: run the ITM forward pass with sequence_output and processed_sample_list to compute cross-entropy loss
review_ITM_init: review the ITM class initialization that sets up BertPooler, BertOnlyNSPHead, and CrossEntropyLoss modules
summarize_ITM_forward: summarize the ITM forward method that extracts labels and computes sequence relationship scores for loss
